metadata.title: Urban Soul Portrait with Neon Accents

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a female figure in a high-contrast studio setting, wearing a textured faux-fur jacket. The lighting is dramatic, featuring a deep black background with a soft blue radial glow on the right side, complemented by glowing neon typography in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast relationship between the dark subject and the bright neon text
Texture contrast between the soft fur jacket and the smooth, glowing background gradient
Color harmony between the cool blue rim lighting and the warm pink/white neon glow
coreInvariants: Deep black negative space on the left
Soft blue atmospheric glow on the right
High-contrast studio lighting on the subject's face and jacket

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered-left, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame, posed with hands on hips.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright neon title in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the textured jacket, then sweeps up to the glowing text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space on the left side emphasizes the subject's silhouette.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool blue (rim light and background glow)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon pink and white (typography and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall saturation, except for the vibrant neon accents.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to black, blue, silver, and neon pink

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses wide, thin geometric strokes with open counters
Subtitle uses a continuous, monolinear script with long swashes
Both elements feature a soft outer glow to simulate neon tubing
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the display text has a crossbar that extends slightly
The script text features a long underline swash extending from the final letter
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Modern geometric sans-serif paired with a casual, expressive handwritten script for a 'cool vs. personal' vibe.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric structure of the display text.
Captures the fluid, monolinear motion of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman with short hair wearing a black-and-white faux fur jacket, hands on hips, high-contrast lighting. Background is solid black on the left, fading into a soft, deep blue radial gradient on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the upper right. Top line: wide geometric sans-serif in white with a pink neon glow. Bottom line: fluid white script with a pink neon glow and a long underline swash. Add a small four-pointed star sparkle above the last letter of the top line.

verificationChecks: Is the fur texture highly visible?
Does the blue glow appear only on the right side?
Is the neon text glowing without obscuring the subject's face?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue background glow
Color of the neon glow (e.g., cyan instead of pink)
Texture density of the fur jacket
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist

mustAchieve: Sharp studio lighting on the subject

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast separation between subject and background.
Ensure the neon glow does not look like a flat stroke.
Verify the script text feels handwritten and fluid.
Confirm the blue rim light matches the background glow direction.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + high-contrast low-key lighting + textured fashion + dual-style neon typography in the upper right quadrant.
